messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up: planning Optimize v1.3 announcement Tue 10:00 PT. Need final changelog bullets, canonical docs links, and canary timing so we can lock the post + webinar invite.

noah_eng: Got it. Draft bullets incoming by EOD tomorrow. Prefer staged canary (5% -> 25% -> full) to avoid demo surprises.

maria_marketing: Staged sounds good. Recommended windows: 2h @5%, 4h @25%, full @+24h.

noah_eng: We'll include automatic fallback to compact model variant and rollback on thresholds (95th latency + error rate).

priya_docs: I'll create /docs/release/optimize-1-3 and /docs/guides/quantization. Need final bullets and an anonymized YAML snippet to include. ETA: tomorrow noon PT.

lena_design: I'll prepare hero + social tiles. Avoid absolute latency numbers in copy.

maria_marketing: Messaging note: highlight "~20% memory reduction" and "fewer tail spikes in chat benchmarks (internal)"; no hard latency claims.

noah_eng: Deployment plan: canary 10:00 PT, health checks in 15m windows, auto-rollback if 95th >15% or errors >0.5%. release-bot will post stage pings.

release-bot: Scheduled canary: 1861112222 (10:00 PT). Pre-launch ping scheduled at 1861112360.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: EOD tomorrow  final changelog. Tomorrow 12:00 PT  docs live. Mon AM  design assets. Tue 10:00 PT  announce + canary. Wed  webinar invite. Flag blockers here ASAP. :thumbsup:
